channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Telangana GST (Amendment) Bill 2026 Tabled in Assembly to Align with National GST Framework
item.description: The Telangana GST (Amendment) Bill, 2026 was introduced in the Assembly to align state GST laws with GST Council recommendations, strengthen administration, and ensure uniform tax implementation.

item.title: Blowout continues at ONGC well in Andhra Pradesh
item.description: Crisis management teams of ONGC and firefighting personnel continued their efforts to control the blowout on the outskirts of Irusumanda village in Malikipuram Mandal.

item.title: Bangladesh polls: BNP opens wide lead over Jamaat as violence risk rises; India on alert
item.description: Last month, the polls suggested a close fight between the BNP and Jamaat-e-Islami. However, the BNP has surged past the Jamaat with 70 per cent of the people, saying they would vote for the party headed by the late Khaleda Zia.

item.title: Three killed in fire at Delhi Metro quarters in Adarsh Nagar
item.description: According to Delhi Fire Services (DFS), they received information at around 02:39 a.m. about a fire on the second floor of one of the buildings in the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) staff quarters in Adarsh Nagar.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty post mild losses as oil and gas stocks trade lower
item.description: Indian benchmark indices posted mild losses on Tuesday, weighed down by losses in oil and gas stocks. Amid impressive corporate updates that had lifted expectations of stronger quarterly earnings, concerns of potential additional tariffs by US weighed on the domestic markets.

item.title: Madras HC orders lighting of lamp at Thiruparankundram Hill
item.description: The Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court on Tuesday upheld an earlier order directing that the traditional Karthigai Deepam be lit on the hilltop at Thiruparankundram Hill, dismissing an appeal filed by the Tamil Nadu government and the temple administration.

item.title: Panic erupts on Gorakhpur-Lokmanya Tilak train following bomb threat, probe on
item.description: Panic erupted on the Gorakhpur-Lokmanya Tilak Express on Tuesday following a bomb threat, prompting swift action from security agencies. Senior police officials, including the Superintendent of Police (SP), along with the entire police force, rushed to the scene.

item.title: 2010 IRCTC tender policy: NHRC seeks probe into minorities reservation by then Railways Minister Mamata Banerjee
item.description: A bench of the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) has directed the Railway Board to investigate a complaint alleging that in 2010, when the incumbent West Bengal Chief Minister, Mamata Banerjee, was the Railways Minister, a tender policy was amended to provide reservation under the guise of minority preference, reducing the statutory reservation for SC/ST/OBC categories to benefit the Muslim community, which is not provided for under the Constitution of India.

item.title: 20 kg heroin seized in Punjab: four arrested
item.description: Last week, the Amritsar Commissionerate Police busted a cross-border drug smuggling cartel with links to Pakistan-based handlers with the arrest of seven accused and recovered 4.075 kg heroin, one kg methamphetamine, commonly known as ICE, and one 9mm Glock pistol from their possession.

item.title: CM Stalin to inaugurate Pongal gift distribution from Chennai ration shop
item.description: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M. K. Stalin will inaugurate the distribution of the Pongal gift package at a fair price shop in Alandur, Chennai, on Thursday, marking the start of the State's annual festive assistance to ration card holders ahead of the harvest festival.
